intro: 22 Signals runs SEO and GEO for Zurich companies that need to rank on google.ch in German, French, Italian and English, and to be named when buyers ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Google AI Overviews who to hire. We fix the technical base, structure each language properly, build trusted mentions and report every month in plain English.

sections.h: Swiss search is several small markets
p: Switzerland is a small country with a complicated search picture. A wealth manager in Zurich may want German-speaking clients across the country, French-speaking clients in Geneva and Lausanne, and international clients who search in English. Each group uses different words, and Swiss users often search differently from people in Germany or France, using Swiss terms, Swiss place names and Swiss spelling.

Many sites lose ground because Google cannot tell which page is meant for whom. A German page written for Germany competes with a much larger German market. A French page with no link to its German twin looks like a separate, weaker site. The first job of any SEO agency Zurich companies hire should be making each language version clear, connected and aimed at Swiss searchers.

GEO, generative engine optimisation, is the work of being named and described correctly when someone asks an AI assistant for a recommendation. A procurement lead at a Zurich insurer might ask ChatGPT for software vendors with Swiss hosting. An expat family might ask Gemini for an English-speaking clinic near Zurich. An investor might ask Claude which advisers specialise in a sector.

Assistants draw on the same foundations as search, plus what other trusted sources say about you. So GEO focuses on clear pages that answer questions directly, consistent descriptions of your business across the web and mentions in the publications, directories and lists that assistants already rely on.

p: We set up each language with its own URLs and correct language and region tags, such as de-CH, fr-CH and it-CH, and link every page to its equivalents. We check that the right version appears for the right searcher and that translated pages are not thin copies of the original.

We deliver our work in English. For content in German, French or Italian, we write briefs and structure, and the copy comes from your team, your translators or localisation partners we arrange. Then we check it for search before it goes live. Machine translation on its own rarely reads well enough for Swiss audiences, and both readers and search engines can tell.

sections.h: How we work: Talk, Plan, Build, Grow
p: Talk is a 15-minute call about the searches and questions that bring you clients. Plan is an audit of your site, your language setup, your listings and your presence in AI answers, followed by a written plan within 5 to 7 days, ranked by impact. Build is the fixes, pages and profile work in priority order, with dates in writing. Grow is monthly reporting, new content and outside mentions that build trust over time.

We will not promise a set number of AI mentions, publish dozens of thin town pages with the place name swapped, buy links or write reviews. Nobody controls exactly what an assistant says. We work on the signals it reads and report the results honestly, including the months when progress is slow.

Much of our search work is monthly SEO and content for law firms, where every claim is checked before it goes live. We bring the same care to Zurich clients in finance, insurance and healthcare, where a careless sentence carries real risk. We have worked with more than 30 companies across the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe and the UAE.

faqs.q: Do you do SEO in German, French and Italian?
faqs.a: We plan and run SEO across all three, plus English. Strategy, technical work and reporting are delivered in English. Copy in other languages comes from your team, your translators or localisation partners, and we brief it, structure it and check it for search before publishing.

faqs.q: Why do our German pages rank in Germany but not in Switzerland?
faqs.a: Usually because the pages are not marked as Swiss German versions, use German rather than Swiss terms and spelling, or lack local signals such as Swiss addresses, listings and links. We fix the language tags, adjust the wording with your translators and build Swiss signals around the pages.

faqs.q: How do Zurich businesses get mentioned in ChatGPT answers?
faqs.a: Assistants rely on your website and, more heavily, on what other trusted sources say about you. Clear pages that answer buyer questions, consistent descriptions across directories and profiles, good reviews and mentions in respected publications all help. We track a fixed set of questions monthly and work on those signals.

faqs.q: Can you guarantee AI answers will name us?
faqs.a: No. Nobody controls what an assistant writes, and anyone who promises otherwise is guessing. We can measure how often you appear for a fixed set of questions, improve the signals assistants depend on and report the trend honestly.

faqs.q: How long before SEO shows results?
faqs.a: Technical and listing fixes show once pages are recrawled. Rankings for competitive Swiss searches take longer, especially in finance and law. We report progress from the first month so you can see which work is moving the numbers.

faqs.q: Do you work on Google Business Profile and Swiss directories?
faqs.a: Yes. We set up and maintain Google Business Profile for each location and keep details consistent across Swiss directories such as local.ch and search.ch, plus the sector directories your buyers use. Consistency helps both maps rankings and AI answers.
